phase_name: Build the Deployed-Tree Fixture Once and Lend It Read-Only

objectives.description: Re-read task 416's live plan headings first
Build the shared deployed-tree fixture once at run-all.sh startup, expose it read-only, add common_test_fixture_overlay for private writable copies
Migrate the genuine consumer suite(s) onto the shared fixture; investigate and document why the other integration-class candidates do not fit
Enforce read-only lending and prove it with a regression suite; classify the new suite in suite-classification.data
Pin common_test_fixture_overlay's own contract (copy semantics, no hardlink-sharing hazard, error paths) in test-common-lib.sh
Document the shared-fixture contract in shell-script-testing.md; record the phase's NET-PROD/NET-TEST/NET-MD deltas and close via Reasoned Exclusions

approaches_tried.approach: Overlay only the shared fixture's .claude/ subtree into a consuming suite's TARGET
approaches_tried.reason: manager.find_orphans(project_dir) resolves the active-extension set from project_dir/.claude-extensions.json and the exclusion set from project_dir/.syncprotect -- both PROJECT-ROOT siblings of .claude/, not contents of it. Omitting them made every declared extension invisible, misclassifying the entire deployed tree as orphaned (743 false findings). Fixed by overlaying all three top-level deploy artifacts.

approaches_tried.approach: Build the shared fixture via a plain (unflagged) deploy-headless.sh call
approaches_tried.reason: deploy-headless.sh's own inline verify-deploy.sh fast-gate pass failed gate 14 (runtime-file-tracking) against a bare scratch repo that never seeded a consumer .gitignore -- a concern specific to deploy-headless.sh's own self-check, irrelevant to what any consumer suite verifies. Fixed by using --skip-verify and accepting exit 0 or 4 (its own documented landed_verify_skipped success code), matching test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh's existing precedent.

approaches_tried.approach: common_test_fixture_overlay implemented via cp -al (hardlinks) then chmod -R u+w the copy
approaches_tried.reason: a hardlink shares the SAME inode as the source; chmod on the link also changes the source's permission bits, silently defeating the read-only-lending contract. Never implemented as code (caught during design, not at runtime); used cp -a --reflink=auto instead (independent inodes, copy-on-write where supported).

deviations.description: Migrate the integration-class suites identified in Phase 12 onto the shared fixture, deleting their own construction blocks.
deviations.reason: Investigated each of the 38 core integration-classified suites directly (not just suite-classification.data's conservative textual-reference reason field): only test-deploy-orphans.sh fits the 'needs a plain deployed tree as inert scaffolding' pattern. test-deploy-propagation.sh, test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh and test-deploy-verify-wiring.sh each deliberately drive multiple/distinct real invocations because the invocation's own variance is what they verify; the remaining rows are textual-reference false positives or (the two named stragglers) already migrated by task 416 Phase 8 onto a non-deploy-headless fixture. Recorded as Reasoned Exclusions, phase closed [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS].
